items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I don't think I know him. He said you talk about him once. I don't know him. I don't know him.

ctx.x: But if musicians, they work, they don't pay no money, nah, you know. They work and pay money, some of them. But when I got back, I went to the white people that raised me, and they got me a couple of jobs through them, you know, a little lightweight, a little yard-working, a house-working. And I stayed on there until they died. And, uh, um...
I don't know who Vermilla is. I don't know who Vermilla is. I asked him who Vermilla is. We talked about him earlier. V-Vernimilla? Vermilla is all the names. Permilla, Vermilla?
Who is Vermilla? Vermilla. Vermilla? Yeah. I don't think I know him. He said you talk about him once. I don't know him. I don't know him. Vermilla.
